version: v1.7 (2026-10-13: off-topic classes — three kinds + honest assistant; every v1.6 scenario and check unchanged; harness h10)
notes: Synthetic business scenarios — no real chats, no real names or numbers. `mode`: auto (the bot's composed system prompt through the completions proxy, with the create_handoff and price_list_search tools simulated by the runner) | panel (the Suggest Replies webhook on staging). `expect` names deterministic checks the runner applies; `tool` sets the simulated create_handoff result. Q1 (v1.3): in a6_/q1p_ the `business` turn is the OWNER's reply as it reaches the bot's memory (an ai row) — the bot must repeat that agreement; q1c_ must NOT assign a time or serve the client's own time as agreed. Roles (v1.4, h7): `client` = the client; `business` = the bot's OWN earlier reply as memory stores it (delivered, unmarked); `owner` = the owner's reply (owner_app / owner_phone memory row); `bot_unknown` = the bot's earlier reply whose delivery is unknown. `owner` and `bot_unknown` reach the model with the mark the memory writers store at the measured ref (apply-history-handoff.py OWNER_MEMORY_PREFIX / UNDELIVERED_MEMORY_PREFIX at --prompts-ref) — before T6 there is none, so the same scenario measures prod's memory on the old ref and the marked memory on the new one. v1.5 (T11b): `no_tool:create_handoff` = the model must not open a request (on a live bot create_handoff records a request and pauses the chat's auto-reply until the owner's explicit «Авто»); it stands on every auto scenario whose question the business data answers and whose design calls for no handoff — decided by the scenario text and the niche rules it exercises, never by a measured result; the classification and the reason for every scenario left unchecked live in eval/test_checks.py.
